output.summary: Tree native to the Atlantic and Gulf coasts of the United States, Mexico's Yucatán coast, Bermuda and parts of the Caribbean. Its trunk bears sharp, strap-like leaves and eventually topples before its tip turns upward and continues growing. Humans eat the fruit and the showy white flowers, which may be eaten raw or cooked.
